title: My Neighbour Waves at Me Every Night at 3 AM #shorts #horror
description: The house next door has been empty for years. So who keeps waving from the window? #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

lines.text: The house next door has been empty for six years.
Last month, a light came on upstairs.
A thin man stood there, waving at me.
Every night, three AM. Same window. Same slow wave.
I called the landlord. He sounded confused.
That house has no power. The windows are boarded.
Last night, I finally waved back.
He stopped. Then he smiled, and stepped away.
A minute later, something knocked on my door.
Three slow knocks. Exactly like his wave.
